uiKit.note: FlClash v0.9.3 pins plugins/prism_ui as a submodule at this commit; FK-box vendors the tree.

layout: flutter/ is FlClash's Flutter app at the pinned commit: lib/, arb/, assets/, plugins/ and the pubspec, compared file by file by tools/verify_flclash_ui.py. The Dart package keeps its name fl_clash and its channel prefix com.follow.clash, so no Dart file is renamed or rewritten. Android host code that FlClash keeps in android/ is ported under app/src/main/java/com/follow/clash/ (see flclash.md).

adaptedFiles.pubspec.yaml: Drops the setup dependency and its hooks.user_defines entry: that package builds FlClash's Go core (libclash), which FK-box replaces with libbox.
adaptedFiles.assets/data/ASN.mmdb: Not bundled: the Kotlin host answers extractAsset for assets/data/* from the APK's assets/geo (app/geo-assets.properties).

fkboxFiles.assets/data/README.md: Keeps the assets/data/ directory the pubspec lists; explains where the geo files come from.
fkboxFiles.core/Clash.Meta/component/ca/ca-certific: FlClash lists this Clash.Meta submodule file as an asset; it is empty at the submodule commit 024245dc (only FlClash's release CI fills it), and FK-box keeps it empty, which lib/common/http.dart skips.
fkboxFiles.android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml: Marks flutter/ as an Android v2-embedding app for the Flutter tool, so pub get writes the plugin list and GeneratedPluginRegistrant that app/ builds; FlClash's own android/ host is ported to app/ instead.

ported.app/src/main/java/com/follow/clash/commo: android/common/.../Components.kt; activities point at FK-box components, no broadcast receiver
android/common/.../Ext.kt without the service notification/foreground/broadcast helpers
ported.app/src/main/java/com/follow/clash/plugi: R from io.nekohasekai.sfa; extractAsset maps assets/data geo files to assets/geo
same channels and methods; start/stop/getRunTime go to FkHost (BoxService) and invokeMethod to FkCore (libbox) instead of FlClash's ServiceController and Go core
ported.app/src/main/java/com/follow/clash/Quick: same actions; start/stop go to BoxService

fkbox.app/src/main/java/com/follow/clash/FkHos: run intent and start time for the service channel, fed by BoxActivity's service status
fkbox.app/src/main/java/com/follow/clash/core/: answers FlClash's Core wire methods (lib/core/method.dart) from the FK-box backend: Clash YAML merged as core/profile_base.go does and run by mihomo, sing-box/Xray JSON run as they are, groups/delay/mode/traffic/connections/logs from libbox, providers, geo, outbound IP and route versions
YAML reading/dumping and FlClash's profile overlay merge (core/profile_base.go) for config.setup and profile.build
Core log events from libbox's log stream while log.start is active
geo.update through libbox GeoUpdate into Libbox.geoDataDir() (mihomo home, Xray asset dir), mirrored into FlClash's home file names, reported as geoUpdate events (core/geo.go)
probe.outboundIp: the given IP-echo URLs fetched by the app (through the VPN while it runs), first answer wins

nativePorts.libbox/core_mihomo_provider.go: FlClash v0.9.3 core/provider.go (be84736): external proxy/rule providers of the in-process mihomo for provider.list/get/update; sideLoad not ported
